profile.name: Kevin Kipyegon
profile.tagline: Accountant. Software Engineer. Data Analyst. AI Builder.
profile.subline: I turn financial data into decisions, using Python, SQL and AI to modernise financial systems across East Africa.
profile.whatsapp_default_text: Hello Kevin, I visited your portfolio and would like to connect.

about.summary: Detail-oriented accounting and technology professional with a Bachelor of Commerce (Accounting Option, Second Class Honours Upper Division) from Kabarak University and over 5 years of progressive experience in financial reporting, budgeting, reconciliation, and tax compliance. Currently expanding into software development and data analysis through PLP Africa (2024–present). Pursuing CPA (KASNEB) and FMVA certifications. Bilingual in English and Swahili.

pillars.title: Financial Acumen
pillars.description: Mastery of IPSAS, IFRS, statutory tax filing (VAT, PAYE, withholding), bank reconciliations, and budgeting controls.

pillars.title: Python Engineering
pillars.description: Building production scripts, automated ETL pipelines, and robust backends that eliminate repetitive manual ledger tasks.

pillars.title: Data-Driven Insight
pillars.description: Transforming messy transactional data into clean relational SQL models, interactive dashboards, and variance trends.

pillars.title: AI Solutions
pillars.description: Implementing LLM-guided ledger audits, plain-language reporting commentary, and intelligent discrepancy detection.
